name: Griselbrand
title: Demon of the Helvault
summary: A demon who drew Avacyn into the Helvault, becoming the target of Liliana Vess's pursuit.
biography: Griselbrand tricked Avacyn into the Helvault, taking Innistrad's protector out of the conflict.
He was also one of the demon creditors to whom Liliana Vess owed a terrible magical bargain.

The Helvault contained both Griselbrand and the angel who had attempted to imprison him. While they were absent, the Avacynian Church lost much of the protection upon which Innistrad's communities relied.

Liliana sought the demon because she hoped to escape the terms of her bargains by killing those who held them. The later crisis at Thraben Cathedral placed her private objective in conflict with the lives of the cathars guarding the prison.

Thalia yielded under threats to her soldiers and broke the Helvault. This released Griselbrand and Avacyn together; it did not mean Liliana intended to rescue Innistrad's protector. The demon's release and Avacyn's restoration are consequences of one rupture.

featuredCard.significance: The Avacyn Restored depiction of the demon who helped cause the Helvault crisis.

source.title: Wizards — Planeswalker's Guide to Avacyn Restored, Part 2
